title: Paradev Raises $11.5M Seed Round for AI Code Editor
summary:
Union Square Ventures and Y Combinator have invested in Paradev, a startup developing a specialized code editor that allows software engineers to coordinate groups of AI coding agents.

The company raised $11.5M in a seed round and recently changed its name from Superset. The funding will be used to expand its tools for automating software development through the orchestration of multiple AI agents.
